nodes.name: visit house after funeral
nodes.description: A week after Rosa's funeral, the Serrano family house is shown as recently emptied and still marked by her presence.
evidence: A week after the funeral, the Serrano row house on Spruce still smelled faintly of the eucalyptus oil the matriarch had rubbed into her wrists each morning, and the kitchen calendar was turned to a month she had not lived to see.

nodes.name: Asha enters with executor key
nodes.description: Asha lets herself into the house using the key provided by the executor and heads upstairs to search Rosa's room.
evidence: Asha let herself in with the key the executor had given her and went straight upstairs, past the front parlor where buyers had already walked through twice, toward the narrow back bedroom where Rosa had slept the last two years.

nodes.name: Asha searches Rosa's bedroom
nodes.description: Asha carefully searches the bedroom for a hidden codicil or other important document.
evidence: She moved carefully there, opening the nightstand, lifting the folded altar cloth from the top of the dresser, checking the underside of a framed photograph for anything tucked behind the backing; if a codicil existed, this was the room a woman would hide it in for the daughter-in-law who had stayed.

nodes.name: Daniel searches mother's desk
nodes.description: Daniel methodically empties his mother's writing desk and inspects it for hidden papers.
evidence: Down the hall, Daniel was already at his mother's writing desk, pulling each drawer fully out and turning it over, sliding a hand along the empty runners and then under the desk itself, working with the brisk competence of a man who did not want to be doing this slowly.

nodes.name: Daniel finds ordinary papers only
nodes.description: Daniel discovers routine documents but no message or bequest addressed to him.
evidence: He found insurance receipts, a Mass card, a rubber-banded stack of unopened bank statements, and nothing in his mother's hand addressed to him.

nodes.name: Daniel resents Asha's search
nodes.description: When Daniel hears Asha upstairs in Rosa's part of the house, he feels a quiet refusal and does not ask what she is doing.
evidence: When he heard Asha's step overhead, in Rosa's part of the house, he did not call up to ask what she was looking for, and the small refusal settled in him before he could name it.

nodes.name: Asha approaches Daniel
nodes.description: Asha comes down the hall toward Daniel, stopping at a careful distance before speaking or acting further.
evidence: Asha came down the hall before Daniel could finish framing the question for himself, stopping a careful arm's length from the wr

nodes.name: Daniel hesitates before asking
nodes.description: Daniel feels a small refusal rising in him before he can fully articulate the question he is about to ask.
evidence: the small refusal settled in him before he could name it

nodes.name: Asha confronts Daniel at the desk
aliases: Asha confronts Daniel at the desk
nodes.description: Asha approaches the writing desk and asks Daniel why he is searching the drawer so thoroughly.
evidence: Asha came down the hall before Daniel could finish framing the question for himself, stopping a careful arm's length from the writing desk where the bottom drawer lay overturned on the rug.
She kept her voice level and asked him why he was searching it quite so thoroughly

nodes.name: Daniel conceals his search
nodes.description: Daniel avoids answering directly, resets the drawer, and asks Asha whether she has seen any old papers upstairs in his mother's room.
evidence: Daniel did not look up at once; he slid the drawer back onto its runners, then straightened and asked, with the same studied lightness, whether she'd come across any old papers upstairs in his mother's room.

nodes.name: Asha notices Daniel's implication
nodes.description: Asha recognizes that Daniel's use of the word 'old' reveals more than he intends.
evidence: The word old did the work he wanted it to do and gave too much away at the same time, and Asha registered both in the half second before she answered.

nodes.name: Asha denies finding papers upstairs
nodes.description: Asha says she found nothing upstairs, including anything hidden in a book or under a drawer liner.
evidence: Asha said evenly that she hadn't found anything upstairs, nothing folded into a book or slid under a drawer liner

nodes.name: Asha questions Daniel's suspicion
nodes.description: Asha asks Daniel why he believes there would be hidden papers to find in his mother's room.
evidence: and then asked him why he thought there would be papers like that to find.

nodes.name: Daniel presses for old papers again
aliases: Daniel presses for old papers again
nodes.description: Daniel steps back from the desk and repeats his question more carefully, emphasizing that he means specifically old papers.
evidence: The repetition of the word told her what the first use had only suggested

Daniel stepped back from the desk, one hand still resting on the corner where the bank statements were stacked, and gave her a tight, closed smile before he asked again, more carefully this time, whether she'd come across anything specifically old in his mother's room.

nodes.name: Asha infers Daniel seeks a specific document
aliases: Asha infers Daniel seeks a specific document
nodes.description: Asha realizes Daniel's repeated mention of something old means he is looking for a particular document and thinks she may already have it.
evidence: The repetition of the word told her what the first use had only suggested, that he was looking for a particular document and believed she might already be holding it.

nodes.name: Asha delays her answer
nodes.description: Asha pauses before answering Daniel, watching his smile stay fixed while she gauges his intentions.
evidence: She let the answer wait a beat longer than was comfortable, watching the smile hold itself in place

nodes.name: Asha notices Daniel avoids naming the document
aliases: Asha notices Daniel avoids naming the document
nodes.description: Asha observes that Daniel has not denied expecting something, but has refused to say what it is.
evidence: noted that he had not denied expecting something, only declined to name it

nodes.name: Overturned drawer remains as evidence
nodes.description: The overturned drawer on the rug underscores that something has been searched or disturbed, and neither person is ready to address it.
evidence: Between them the overturned drawer lay on the rug like evidence neither of them was ready to discuss

nodes.name: Asha asks which old paper Daniel wants
aliases: Asha asks which old paper Daniel wants
nodes.description: Asha directly asks Daniel which specific old paper he expects to find.
evidence: Asha kept her face still and asked him which old paper, exactly, he expected to find.

nodes.name: Daniel avoids answering directly
nodes.description: Daniel refuses to identify the paper and instead shifts the conversation away from the question.
evidence: Daniel did not answer it directly.

nodes.name: Daniel hides the bank statements
nodes.description: Daniel picks up the rubber-banded bundle of bank statements and places it behind him on a chair, removing it from Asha's reach.
evidence: the bank statements moved out of her reach
Instead he gathered the rubber-banded bundle off the corner of the desk, set it on the chair behind him as though tidying

nodes.name: Daniel steps back and probes upstairs rooms
aliases: Daniel steps back and probes upstairs rooms
nodes.description: Daniel retreats from the desk and asks whether Asha has searched other upstairs rooms, including the linen closet and cedar chest.
evidence: He asked, with the same careful lightness he had used before, whether there were other rooms upstairs she hadn't gone through yet, the linen closet maybe, the cedar chest at the foot of the bed
and stepped back from the furniture with a smile that did not reach the rest of his face

nodes.name: Asha registers Daniel's evasiveness
nodes.description: Asha mentally catalogs Daniel's fixed smile, the moved bank statements, and his continued refusal to name what he wants.
evidence: Asha noted the smile, and the bank statements moved out of her reach, and the fact that he had again declined to name what he was looking for

nodes.name: Asha notices Daniel's evasiveness
nodes.description: Asha observes Daniel's smile, the removed bank statements, and his refusal to say what he is looking for, while staying silent.
evidence: Asha noted the smile, and the bank statements moved out of her reach, and the fact that he had again declined to name what he was looking for, and she let the hallway hold all three things without remarking on any of them.

nodes.name: Asha denies searching hidden rooms
nodes.description: Asha says she has not been in the linen closet or cedar chest and challenges Daniel to explain why he suspects those places.
evidence: Asha did not move toward the stairs. She said she hadn't been in the linen closet or the cedar chest, then asked him, in the same procedural voice she had used about the drawer, why those rooms in particular came to mind.

nodes.name: Daniel explains his suspicion
nodes.description: Daniel offers a plausible story that his mother hid things in linens and other unlikely places.
evidence: Daniel held his smile a beat too long before stepping further back from the desk, his hand finally leaving the corner where the bank statements had been, and offered that his mother used to tuck things into linens, sweaters, anywhere except the places a person would think to look.

nodes.name: Asha recognizes Daniel's prepared excuse
nodes.description: Asha realizes Daniel had a ready explanation for the linen closet but not for the desk he already searched.
evidence: The answer was almost reasonable, and that was what Asha noted: that he had a story ready for the linen closet but had not had one ready for the desk he'd already overturned.

nodes.name: Asha approaches the statements
nodes.description: Asha slowly reaches toward the chair with the rubber-banded bank statements, keeping her expression neutral.
evidence: Asha took one slow step toward the chair where Daniel had set the rubber-banded statements, her hand half-extended, her face arranged into the same neutral she had used for the drawer.

nodes.name: Daniel blocks Asha's reach
nodes.description: Daniel shifts to intercept Asha and resumes his smile before she can take the statements.
evidence: Daniel's weight shifted to intercept her, the smile coming back too quickly

nodes.name: Rosa interrupts the confrontation
nodes.description: Rosa emerges from the hallway carrying a folded dish towel and clears her throat to speak before Asha and Daniel can continue.
evidence: before either of them spoke, Rosa stepped from the dim end of the hall where the eucalyptus smell was thickest, a folded dish towel still in her hands. She cleared her throat

nodes.name: Rosa confronts Daniel about the linen closet
aliases: Rosa confronts Daniel about the linen closet
nodes.description: Rosa steps out from the hallway and asks Daniel why he has suddenly become interested in the linen closet after ignoring it for years.
evidence: Rosa stepped from the dim end of the hall where the eucalyptus smell was thickest, a folded dish towel still in her hands.
She cleared her throat and asked Daniel, plainly, why the linen closet had become so interesting to him this week when he had not opened it once in the years his mother was alive.

nodes.name: Daniel hesitates under scrutiny
nodes.description: Daniel freezes mid-motion as Rosa questions him, while Asha waits to see whether he will answer Rosa or her first.
evidence: Daniel's hand stopped halfway to the chair.
Asha did not pick up the bundle yet; she only let her fingers stay near it, and watched him decide whether to answer the housekeeper or the daughter first.

nodes.name: Asha takes the bundle from the chair
aliases: Asha takes the bundle from the chair
nodes.description: Asha moves up to the chair and lifts the rubber-banded bundle off it without rushing, keeping her attention on Daniel.
evidence: Asha closed the last few inches of distance to the chair and lifted the rubber-banded bundle off the seat without hurrying, her eyes on Daniel rather than on the statements in her hand.

nodes.name: Daniel loses his blocking position
nodes.description: Daniel's attempt to block Asha fails, leaving him awkward and unable to respond cleanly.
evidence: Daniel's weight had been set to step into her path, and now he had nowhere clean to put it;
the hand that had reached after her hung at his side and then went, uselessly, to the back of his neck.

nodes.name: Rosa accuses Daniel of lying
nodes.description: Watching Daniel's discomfort, Rosa asks who taught him to lie with such a polite smile.
evidence: From the dim end of the hallway Rosa folded the dish towel slowly over her knuckles, watching the way his shoulders had reorganized themselves, and asked him who had taught him to lie with such a polite smile.

nodes.name: Daniel refuses to answer
nodes.description: Daniel stays silent as the tension between the three of them sharpens.
evidence: Daniel did not answer;

nodes.name: Asha senses the bundle matters less than Daniel's delay
aliases: Asha senses the bundle matters less than Daniel's delay
nodes.description: Asha realizes that Daniel's effort to keep the bundle from her is more revealing than whatever the bundle contains.
evidence: Asha felt the bundle in her palm and understood, without having opened it yet, that whatever was inside would matter less than the seconds he had just spent trying to keep it from her.

nodes.name: Asha opens the rubber-banded bundle
nodes.description: Asha removes the rubber band and begins to fan through the papers inside the bundle.
evidence: Asha slid the rubber band off with her thumb and let it drop onto the chair seat, fanning the state

nodes.name: Asha inspects the bank statements
nodes.description: Asha removes the rubber band and fans through the statements, searching for missing months and unfamiliar handwriting.
evidence: Asha slid the rubber band off with her thumb and let it drop onto the chair seat, fanning the statements just enough to read the corners, her eyes lifting back to Daniel between each page.
She was looking for the months that should have been there and weren't, for any handwriting that didn't belong to a bank

nodes.name: Daniel remains tense and motionless
nodes.description: Daniel watches Asha examine the statements with a rigid stillness, as if any movement would worsen the situation.

nodes.name: Rosa brings up the blue folder
aliases: Rosa brings up the blue folder

evidence: Before he found whatever sentence he was assembling, Rosa stepped further into the light, set the folded dish towel down on the small table by the hall mirror, and asked him, without raising her voice, whether he remembered the blue folder in the attic, the one his mother kept on the shelf above the winter coats.

nodes.name: Daniel lowers his hand from his neck
aliases: Daniel lowers his hand from his neck
nodes.description: Rosa's question causes Daniel to slowly drop the hand at the back of his neck, signaling his discomfort.
evidence: The hand at the back of his neck came down slowly.

nodes.name: Asha withholds a response

evidence: Asha did not look up from the statements, but her thumb stopped moving on the page, and she let the silence widen so he would have to step into it himself.

nodes.name: Asha demands the folder's location
nodes.description: Asha looks Daniel in the eye and asks where exactly the blue folder is in the attic.
evidence: "The blue folder," she said, flat as a clerk reading a docket. "Where exactly in the attic?"
Asha lifted her eyes from the fanned pages and held Daniel's gaze across the narrow hall, the rubber band still curled on the chair seat between them.

nodes.name: Daniel deflects Rosa's question
nodes.description: Daniel gives a strained laugh and turns to Rosa, trying to suggest she may be mistaken about the folder and its shelf.
evidence: Daniel let out a short laugh that didn't reach anywhere near his eyes and turned his head toward Rosa, asking whether she was sure she wasn't thinking of some other shelf, some other year

nodes.name: Daniel deflects Rosa's concern
nodes.description: Daniel gives a short laugh and turns toward Rosa, implying she may be mistaken about which shelf or year the folder belongs to.
evidence: out a short laugh that didn't reach anywhere near his eyes and turned his head toward Rosa, asking whether she was sure she wasn't thinking of some other shelf, some other year, his mother had kept so many folders.

nodes.name: Rosa stays silent

nodes.name: Asha notices Daniel shifting toward Rosa
aliases: Asha notices Daniel shifting toward Rosa

evidence: Asha noted the second small movement of his, the way his weight shifted again toward Rosa instead of toward her, as if the easier person to discredit was the one who had lived in the house longest.

nodes.name: Asha waits on missing statement

nodes.name: Asha asks about the blue folder
aliases: Asha asks about the blue folder

nodes.name: Daniel tries to turn back to Rosa

evidence: she looked only at Asha and tipped her chin once toward the ceiling, the small definite movement of a person who had carried laundry up those stairs for thirty years and knew exactly which board creaked under the shelf above the winter coats.

nodes.name: Asha accepts Rosa's confirmation

evidence: Asha caught the nod and held it

nodes.name: Daniel loses control of the exchange
aliases: Daniel loses control of the exchange
